text:
Maya_marketing: Quick idea 1: small "Snack Labs" refapp series (4 tiny tutorials + one-click deploy). Goal: fast wins for devs + inbound. Need: short launch post, 1-paragraph benchmark snapshot, 25m demo webinar, and clear lead routing. Target: go-live in 9 days.

Priya_devrel: I can own the tutorial templates + repo structure. Format: README (1 page), one-line quickstart, demo GIF, scripts/bench.sh.

Leo_eng: I'll add a tiny perf box per repo: p95 latency, tok/s, cost/token, recommended quant. Short bench script that outputs p50/p95 is fine.

Alex_growth: Routing plan: HubSpot form with hidden utm=snack-labs + select menu for which refapp. Micro-landing per refapp so we can tag interest. SDR routing -> inbound pool "snack-labs".

Maya_marketing: Launch post outline: opener (dev speed), bench snapshot, 3 GIFs, repo CTA, webinar signup. Headline ideas?

Priya_devrel: "Ship an LLM feature in minutes: Snack Labs" or "Snack Labs: 4 tiny refapps to kickstart LLM features". Keep dev-focused.

Leo_eng: Bench narrative: highlight predictability (p95) and cost. One line on fallback: "Redwood will route to cheaper quantized variants if needed to keep latency SLOs."

Alex_growth: Webinar: 25m demo + 10m Q&A. Gate with HS form, include checkbox "Help me deploy" to prioritize leads. I'll handle tracking and UTM.

Sam_ops: I'll hook CI so DeployBot posts preview URLs in #marketing when builds succeed. Also set up Zapier mapping: form -> HubSpot -> assign tag snack-labs.

DesignBot: GIF specs: 800x450, 3-5s loop, annotated captions. I'll drop templates in the design drive.

Maya_marketing: Assignments: Priya = tutorials + GIF assets; Leo = bench scripts + blurbs; Alex = landing + HS form + tracking; Sam = CI hooks + Zap mapping; DesignBot = GIF templates. I'll draft launch copy by day 3.

Priya_devrel: One tiny suggestion: include this one-liner in each README:
```
redwood deploy snack-lab-1 --quickstart
```
Keeps it approachable.

Leo_eng: Agreed. bench script skeleton in repo: `scripts/bench.sh` -> curl loop, compute p50/p95, print cost est.

Alex_growth: I'll prepare three social variants (short, mid, long) and run a short A/B on the short variant in the community account.

Sam_ops: Ops note: ensure HubSpot form keeps GDPR opt-in. Also add hidden field for refapp id.

Maya_marketing: Timeline check: draft copy + landing by day 3, repos + benches by day 6, QA + go-live + webinar signups live day 9. Everyone good?

All: 👍

Maya_marketing: Tagging @Priya_devrel @Leo_eng @Alex_growth @Sam_ops @DesignBot. I'll post a follow-up with draft social copy.
